label: late original-phase o/m/x/k input in sequences starting with y/i/g/0/l/j/b/a
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase (99% of mass), at positions 4-8 (peak at t=5-6), never at t<3 and never during copy. Only a weak trace remains at <DEL>. It acts like a conjunction of graded factors. The current input is o, m, x or k (5-6.5x lift, 73% of mass; d/f/e weaker). The sequence first token is y, i, g, 0 (strongest y) or l/j/b/a. The input is usually a first occurrence. Rate rises with L. Top activations are o/m/x inputs at t=5-7 in sequences starting with y. The conjunction gets dev F1 0.48 (precision 0.58, recall 0.41, mass recall 0.56). Missed activations are mostly weak firings on other letters. False positives are o/m/x/k late inputs in sequences whose prefix does not match. It does not fire on early positions, copy-phase steps, or repeated tokens.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: o, m, x, k, d, f; least: c, j, g, i) and the first original token (most: y, i, g, 0, l, j; least: e, o, m, x); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, t=5, t=7.
